resources.string: Open PiuLink Host on the Windows computer and keep it awake. You can find it when both devices are on the same local network, including Ethernet.
Set up access from another network
Find a computer on this network

Install Tailscale on both your phone and computer. Sign in to the same account, or use a network where this computer is shared with you.\n\nTurn on Tailscale and approve its Android VPN request, then return here. If another VPN is active, you may need to switch to Tailscale.
Tailscale is installed. Its sign-in and connection status must be checked in Tailscale; installation alone does not mean the computer is reachable.
Tailscale is not installed on this phone.
Same Wi-Fi only — skip for now

Copy the computer’s Tailscale IP address or device DNS name into Add computer. PiuLink will check whether the computer responds.\n\nThen select the computer to pair and enter the displayed PIN in PiuLink Host. Pairing is saved for future connections. On the same Wi-Fi, you can also choose a discovered computer.
Choose the display and stream resolution and frame rate. Applying briefly disconnects and reconnects the stream. Apps on your PC keep running.
